pages.text: Each weapon type has two ratings, from $(4)Very low$() to $(2)Excellent$():$(br2)$(li)$(l)Overpower$(): how hard its hits push an enemy's bar.$(li)$(l)Glare Strike$(): how easy it is to counter with a $(l:bromax_battle:glare/glare_strike)Glare Strike$().

Investing in Overpower costs a little raw damage: every level above Standard trims about 1.5% from the weapon's hits, and every level below adds it back.$(br2)A greatsword is a bar-breaker that struggles to counter; a rapier barely dents a bar but counters effortlessly. A quarterstaff does both, and pays for it in damage.
